article.story: HIGH POINT, N.C. -- — Braden Hausen had 18 points in High Point's 93-47 victory over Bryant on Monday night. Hausen shot 6 for 8 (3 for 5 from 3-point range) and 3 of 3 from the free-throw line for the Panthers (11-3). Scotty Washington scored 17 points while shooting 6 for 7 (2 for 3 from 3-point range) and 3 of 4 from the free-throw line. Cam'Ron Fletcher had 14 points and shot 5 for 8, including 2 for 4 from beyond the arc. The Bulldogs (3-10) were led by Quincy Allen, who finished with 14 points and two steals. Ashley Sims II added eight points and two blocks for Bryant. Gio Sanford had seven points. ------ The Associated Press created this story using technology provided by Data Skrive and data from Sportradar.
